text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Hm? 
What on earth am I reciting...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
How could "morning dew" ever 
cling to the "moon"? ...How foolish.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
This is hardly the time to be composing 
poetry... 
...For now, I must rest.

Phalaenopsis seems to have accumulated 
fatigue from back-to-back races. 
Perhaps I should reconsider our race 
schedule.
